description: A Meteor Client addon for automated Baritone control.

mods.name: CMWare
mods.description: CMWare - lightweight Meteor addon for Baritone safety.

releases.notes:
### **CMWare v0.2.2**

- AutoStopThreshold HUD: Now correctly displays when you exceed your configured coordinates. No more phantom “OFF” states.

- AutoStop Module: Improved logic for triggering stops once thresholds are breached; respects the “stop-once” setting.

- HUD Text: Larger and easier to read.

- Code Improvements: Removed unnecessary reflection hacks; category registration simplified and more stable.

- Bug Fixes: Fixes for modules not registering correctly and off-state HUD display issues.

### Installation:
 Place the CMWare-0.2.2.jar in your mods folder and launch.
Requires Fabric 1.21.8 and equivalent latest Meteor build.
